'''Wataru Takagi''' (Japanese: '''高木渉''' ''Takagi Wataru'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Takagi was born on July 25, 1966 in {{wp|Chiba Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and voiced a number of characters for many Japanese anime series. Takagi joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during the {{aniseries|OS}}, voicing [[Fergus]] in [[M01|the first movie]] before moving on to other roles. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Arts Vision}} and was once a member of the Katsuta Voice Actor's Academy.
